ideas.title: Owner admin draft pack
ideas.why: Owners lose 22.4% of time to admin plus legal and compliance and 27% say less day-to-day admin would accelerate growth, so drafts that a person approves save time without changing handoffs

ideas.title: Weekly finance admin summarizer
ideas.why: Owners spend 11 hours weekly on admin or finance tasks and 1 hour 36 minutes daily on unproductive tasks, so a code-structured summary with owner approval focuses effort

ideas.principle_risk: code decides structure and numbers and the model writes words
ideas.title: Receipt snap to ledger with check
ideas.why: 77.6% still manually store some receipts while paper offices lose about six hours weekly searching documents and AI struggles past 95% on forms, so code extracts amounts and a person approves

ideas.title: Paper notebook digitizer
ideas.why: 45% of SMB operations still rely on paper and 44% of informal microbusinesses keep systematic records mostly in notebooks, so phone capture into code-defined fields with approval bridges paper to digital

ideas.principle_risk: nothing is kept about how a person works
ideas.title: Role handbook builder
ideas.why: 84% say retiree knowledge loss is a big loss with 4.8 months average onboarding and 20% salary replacement cost, so role-level guides built from approved documents speed handover

ideas.title: No-train trust mode
ideas.why: 52% worry about future workplace AI use and 66% fear misuse of worker evaluation data with 74% wanting legislation on training with employee data, so explicit no-training plus approval logs build trust

ideas.principle_risk: never evaluate, rank or monitor people
ideas.title: Approved starter seats to replace shadow AI
ideas.why: 71% of UK employees used unapproved shadow AI while only 43% of 2-9 employee businesses use AI for work, so low-friction approved seats with task-only prompts reduce risky workarounds
